body.message:
Hi! I came across your listing and I know this is advertised as a long-term rental, but I wanted to check if the landlord might be open to a short-term stay of a couple of months?

I’m looking for a furnished studio around AED 7–8k/month all-inclusive. Ideally either September until the end of November if we can agree on a good rate for the full period, or mid-October until the end of November.

If this particular landlord isn’t open to short-term, perhaps you have another option or know someone who does? I’m mainly looking around Downtown / Business Bay in a similar price range.

Thank you! 😊
